description: This donut chart, titled “Entity topic distribution,” visually represents the proportional breakdown of five distinct topics within the $M^3EL$ dataset, with each category shown as a colored segment around a central white space. The chart contains five slices, each labeled with its corresponding percentage: the largest segment, colored light blue, accounts for 41.2% and is labeled “Moive”; the second largest, in pink, represents 30.5% and is labeled “Person”; a light green segment makes up 14.9% and corresponds to “Common”; a pale yellow slice is 9.1% and labeled “Book”; and the smallest segment, lavender, is 4.3% and labeled “Sport.” A legend positioned in the center identifies each color with its topic. Each percentage value is also displayed directly within its respective slice, and the segments are arranged in descending order of size, starting from the top and moving clockwise.
